method.selection: First 27 JSON records in chronological filename order for each run; subsequent manual trials excluded.
method.driver: Internal UI timer; no external accessibility or computer-use queries during animation.
method.autosave: Deferred until no page turn is active.
method.quantiles: Per-turn quantiles use nearest rank. Aggregates are medians of the 27 per-turn p50/p95 values, not pooled sample quantiles. Maximum is the largest recorded value across all turns.
method.draw_start_interval: Elapsed time between overlay drawRect starts. This is not a display-presentation or GPU-completion measurement.
method.draw_cpu_time: CPU time inside overlay drawRect; CoreGraphics may defer rasterization and compositing.
method.limitations: One local debug-build run per strategy across nine books. These measurements do not guarantee 60 fps on every document or device.

change: During an active settling turn, display the invalidated overlay in the same timer tick. Geometry, texture sampling, and idle behavior are unchanged.
